messages:
kevin_support: Heads-up — BrightGate just reported onboarding failures. Embed pipeline returns 500s intermittently, ~55% of requests failing. Customer delivery lead is frustrated, called in for an urgent fix. Marking as potential renewal-risk if unresolved this week.

mina_csm: Ack. Do we have logs + repro steps? Who's the customer contact?

kevin_support: Customer PM is @elaine from BrightGate (elaine@brightgate.com). Repro steps: bulk CSV upload -> async ingest -> call /v1/embeddings -> 500. Happens ~1 in 2 attempts. Pasting latest error snippet:

```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d
{"error":"model inference failed: kv-cache OOM on shard-2"}
```

kevin_support: Also seeing spike in token queue latency (~420ms -> 1.8s) around the same time.

oliver_se: Sounds like KV-cache thrashing on their sequence length + small batch size. Short-term: can we force smaller max_seq or enable prefix cache for that tenant? If we can change routing to a model-variant with more tolerant memory profile, that might buy us time.

mina_csm: Good call. Kevin, can you test routing them to redwood/mosaic-x-lr-8b-quant (compat) and see if failures stop? If yes, we'll propose a migration path.

kevin_support: On it. Quick test done — switched to mosaic-x-lr-8b-quant for a handful of requests. Failures dropped to 2/100. Seems stable.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-8721. Priority: P1. Owner: kevin_support. Linked channel: #customer-success.

sara_cs: Thanks team. I'll own the CS-side comms. Drafting a short message for Elaine to set expectations and offer an immediate walkthrough. Please review: 

"Hi Elaine — thanks for the report and sorry for the disruption. We've identified a temporary routing workaround and routed your requests to a compatible model variant which should stop the 500s. We'd like to run a 30-min screen-share to validate your bulk ingest and agree on a migration plan that keeps your rollout on track. Are you available today at 4pm PT or tomorrow morning? We'll also follow up with a postmortem and timeline for a permanent fix. — Sara (Redwood CS)"

mina_csm: LGTM. Add a bullet about rollback plan if we see regression: small traffic percent -> monitor 1h -> full cutover.

kevin_support: I'll prepare a quick step-by-step we can run on the call if they agree:
1) Turn on compat routing (temp)
2) Run sample ingest of 100 rows
3) Validate success rate >= 98%
4) If OK, schedule migration to mosaic-x variant for production window

oliver_se: For the permanent fix, I'll open an infra ticket to tune KV allocation per-tenant and add prefilling heuristics. ETA for proposal: 48 hours.

mina_csm: Comms plan approved. Owner: sara_cs for customer comms, kevin_support for live triage, oliver_se for infra fix.

kevin_support: Booked a 30-min slot with Elaine for today 4pm PT — invite sent. I'll run the reproduction + mitigation checklist during the call.

incident-bot: Updated INC-8721: SLA timer paused for customer call.

mina_csm: Post-call, let's capture: a) root cause notes, b) recommended migration steps, c) acceptance test (sample CSV) to include in renewal health pack. Also ask Elaine for feedback on onboarding friction — capture in Gainsight/CS notes.

sara_cs: Will capture feedback and add to the customer's health dashboard. I'll flag renewal risk as 'at-risk' until we have a stable 24-hour window after migration.

kevin_support: Quick note for ops: command to flip routing for tenant (internal only):

```
POST /internal/v1/tenants/route
{ "tenant_id": "brightgate-001", "route_to": "mosaic-x-lr-8b-quant", "reason": "emergency_compat_mitigation" }
```

oliver_se: Thanks. I'll pick up infra ticket and include KV-cache telemetry dashboards for BrightGate so CS can monitor success rate live.

mina_csm: Great work. After call, sara_cs — ping here with postmortem summary and next steps. We'll convert this to a proactive renewal playbook item if the customer indicates onboarding impact. :eyes:

sara_cs: Will do.

kevin_support: Closing loop — mitigation working in limited tests. Escalation to CS done. Continuing live triage at 4pm PT.
